svg.title: Leaf-spine topology
svg.desc: Two spine switches connect two leaves. Leaf 1 attaches existing compute Nodes 12 and 13; Leaf 2 attaches Node 14. They own free GPU units 87, 91, and 95 respectively. Node 14 has a down NIC, so GPU 95 is absent from the query result even though its resource unit remains free. Blue highlights one usable route from spine-1 through Leaf 1 to Node 12. GpuCandidateFinder returns the reachable nodes, their free GPU IDs, and their paths.
svg.metadata: Lettering: Virgil by Ellinor Rapp. SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://github.com/excalidraw/virgil

g.aria-label: Switches, ports and physical links connect the existing compute nodes.
GPU 95 is free, but Node 14 is unreachable while its NIC is down.
Blue marks one usable route. The cable to Node 14 remains in the physical model.
